concept.material: heavy cast iron and weathered silver plate
concept.internal_detail: fine coiled linkages and miniature balance wheels
concept.button: a flush silver stud at the top edge
concept.shell_mechanic: The cast iron medallion unlatches at its beveled rim and the top plate folds back like a hinged locket
concept.emerging_parts: A tapering segmented spine, two wide pectoral fins of slotted silver, and a long slender whip tail
concept.signature_move: its broad silver pectoral fins pivot upward together on their hinges and tilt back down in a steady mechanical stroke
concept.turkish: spotted ratfish: Benekli fare baligi (Derin denizlerde yasayan kikinogutlu balik) — pahli dairesel madalyon, agir dokme demir ve hava kosullarina dayanikli gumus kaplama

concept.internal_detail: miniature piston rods and copper cogs
concept.shell_mechanic: The hexagonal metal casing separates into three outer panels that drop away to the sides
concept.emerging_parts: Two long jointed stilts and a crested head plate on a neck pivot
concept.signature_move: its crested head plate swings forward on its neck pivot and snaps upward with a crisp gear click
concept.turkish: red-legged seriema: Kırmızı bacaklı seriema (Güney Amerika'da yaşayan büyük kuş) — pahlı altıgen kartuş, patine pirinç ve dövme demir
